summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MIS Dashboard PDF download feature and premium UI. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified working - PDF download, Excel download, tab navigation, center filter, period selector all functional.

mis_dashboard_page_load.details: MIS Dashboard loads with premium dark-themed UI, KPI cards with color gradients, Recharts-based charts

pdf_download_button.details: PDF button triggers /api/mis/download-pdf and returns valid PDF file (~193KB). Downloaded as MIS_Report_All_Centers_2026-03-01_to_2026-03-27.pdf

excel_download_button.details: Excel button generates XLSX file. Downloaded as MIS_Report_PB-HSR_2026-01-01_to_2026-03-27.xlsx

tab_navigation.details: All 7 tabs work: Overview, Working Capital, Centers, Expenses, Alerts, Quarterly, Performers

center_filter_dropdown.details: Center dropdown shows All Centers + 10 specific centers (PB-HSR, PB-TH, PB-SN, PB-DV, PB-HW, PB-KN, PB-KAL, PB-MGT, PB-PERTH, PB-DELETE). Filtering updates data correctly.

period_selector.details: Period selector works with Current Month, Current Quarter, Last 3 Months, YTD, Custom options

backend_pdf_endpoint_all_centers.details: /api/mis/download-pdf returns 200 with valid PDF for center='all'. Content-Type: application/pdf, Content-Disposition includes filename

backend_pdf_endpoint_specific_center.details: /api/mis/download-pdf returns 200 with valid PDF for center='PB-PERTH' (international center)

backend_overview_endpoint.details: /api/mis/overview returns proper data structure with period, summary, changes, centers fields

kpi_cards.details: 6 KPI cards displayed: Total Sales, Total Expenses, Net Profit, Profit Margin, Total Guests, Avg/Bill with color gradients

alerts_banner.details: 5 Alerts Detected banner shows expense alerts (OVER TIME, REFUND TO GUESTS, POSTAGE & COURIER, MEDICAL EXPENSES, RENT PAID SHOP)

working_capital_tab.details: Working Capital tab shows Total Working Capital, Total Revenue, Total Outflow with trend chart and daily breakdown table

performers_tab.details: Performers tab shows Top by Sales, Top by Margin, Needs Attention, At Risk (Low Margin) sections

purnabramha_logo_in_pdf.details: pb_logo.png exists at /app/backend/pb_logo.png (133KB). PDF generation uses ReportLab with logo embedding.
